text:
maria: Quick heads-up — want to lock the benchmark narrative for next week's launch post + webinar. Need final chart set and 2x short copy variants.
eli: high level: focus on unit economics (tokens/$) + predictable latency under load. Avoid deep ML jargon.
sam: for visuals I can do 3 tiles: 1) tokens-per-dollar slope, 2) p95/p99 latency vs throughput, 3) cost-breakdown (batching + quantization wins). Want sketch by EOD.
ben: love that. can we show a single customer persona overlay (chatbot vs summarization) so buyers see relatable delta?
maria: yes — two personas: "support bot (short prompts)" and "summarizer (long prompts)". Callouts: typical seq len and tokens/session.
jess: routing + CTA question: should inbound lead flow go to self-serve trial for SMB, but sales for >50k ARR? or route webinar signups to AE nurture?
eli: route: webinar signups -> nurture sequence (email + CTA to trial), but tag by company size for AE handoff. We should include that routing in a one-pager.
sam: mockups: I can do both a wide hero chart and a narrow IG-friendly tile. Which color palette? prefer warm reds/teal to match bench visuals.
maria: use existing bench palette but tweak contrast for accessibility. Also need two headline options: short social + longer subhead for blog.
ben: short headline option A: "More predictable inference costs. Better latency at scale." Option B: "Ship LLM features without the surprise bill."
jess: social CTAs: A) "See the numbers -> join webinar" B) "Try the latency calculator" — both should feed different landing anchors.
eli: include a tiny interactive: tokens-to-$ calculator for the blog. devex team can reuse it in the console later.
launch-bot: deploy reminder — webinar registration page draft deployed to /launch/bench-narrative/v2 at 2441239900
maria: nice. need two short tweet-length intros (<=280): 

- Variant 1: "Benchmarked real workloads: how batching, quantization, and smart routing cut inference costs and kept p99 latency under control. Join our webinar to see charts + a live Q&A. -> link"
- Variant 2: "Stop guessing inference spend. New benchmarks show predictable tokens-per-$ across workloads. Sign up for our launch webinar for a walkthrough. -> link"

sam: microcopy ask: inside charts label axes as tokens/request and $/1000 tokens. annotate p95/p99 lines.
ben: can we include a tiny ops note: "fallback to cheaper variant under burst to preserve SLOs" as a footnote in the blog so enterprises know about graceful degradation.
maria: yep. also add 2 short testimonial blurbs from pilot customers — keep anonymous if needed: one on latency, one on cost.
jess: for routing: I'll wire up the registration form to add fields: company size, primary workload, interest (hosted/dedicated/private). that'll drive the AE tags.
eli: timeline: design by today, copy by tomorrow morning, final landing + webinar slides Thurs AM, rehearsal Thurs afternoon.
maria: blockers?
sam: need the sample dataset to draw realistic throughput lines. can someone drop numbers?
ben: dropping a small table here: 
```
workload, seq_len, req_per_min, tokens_per_req
support, 32, 1200, 60
summarization, 1024, 60, 1200
search-embeds, 128, 800, 256
```
use these to generate the three chart series.
maria: perfect. i'll draft the one-pager with routing map and CTA matrix. ping me when designs are up. :thumbsup:
eli: I'll produce the short webinar talking points: 1) how we measure tokens/$; 2) latency regimes and SLOs; 3) real customer wins; 4) product demo + Q&A.
jess: pre-webinar email plan: 3 touches (invite, reminder, day-of) + post-webinar recording + CTA to try. i'll draft sequences.
launch-bot: calendar event created: "Benchmark launch webinar" on 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC — attendees: marketing, sales, eng. event_id: ev-24412
maria: great — final asks: sam upload hero + tile drafts to Figma under "bench-launch/visuals"; ben & eli approve copy in doc; jess wire forms; i'll pull the landing together and share final link here.
eli: tiny copy polish suggestion for headline B: change "surprise bill" -> "bill surprises" reads better in headline.
ben: +1.
maria: thanks team — sprinting. will update thread when landing is live. :rocket:
